name: Boyd's Key West Campground
note: A family-run campground since 1963 with about 200 RV and 50 tent sites on Stock Island, 5 miles from Duval Street. US callers book by phone and international guests by a request form; there is no online booking. Weekly stays may be required on some site types from Oct 15 to Apr 30. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site boydscampground.com read 2026-10-30 (Stay, FAQ, property map, rate sheet PDF dated 9-29-26): full-hookup 30/50-amp RV sites on gravel or concrete pads for RVs up to 45 ft (Inland, Premium Inland, Dockside Marina View, Premium Dockside, Open Water View), open 365 days, with posted daily rates in every season from May 1 2026; bookings are taken by phone (305-294-1465) and the operator's own request form, which a 6-nights-or-less 'Daily Reservations' deposit policy confirms; Google Maps open at the pin with a phone, 4.5/1,885; Good Sam directory lists it as a CAMPGROUND (not a condo or membership park); family-owned since 1963 (Modern Campground 2023-04-12: 200 RV + 50 tent sites) -> a real transient RV campground, not hurricane-closed. Price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator sells 'Open Water View' and 'Dockside' RV sites and labels the water 'Ocean' on its site map (boydscampground.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Boyds_Site_Map.jpg). That only triggered the audit. Esri World Imagery (sat.py, every frame rendered and read): a 1.8 km frame at 24.5712,-81.7339, a 500 m frame at 24.5712,-81.7335 and a 180 m frame at 24.5720,-81.7322. They show the campground on the east shore of Stock Island. Its Porpoise Point peninsula runs NE into open shallow flats about 1 km wide, with moored boats, between Stock Island and Boca Chica, opening south to the Atlantic. The outer (east/south) row of pads on the peninsula loop backs onto a riprap edge, with RVs a few metres from the open water and no road, lot or treeline between. This is open water directly in front of the sites, not a canal. The inner row faces the small marina basin with its docks, which opens straight onto the same flats within tens of metres. Inland rows are not on the water. Bayfront earned by the peninsula's open-water row.
fees_source: Operator rate sheet PDF (boydscampground.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Rate-Sheet-Boyds-No-Standard-9-29-26-v2-1.pdf, daily rates effective May 1 2026, party of two, before 12.5% tax), read 2026-10-30. Daily (weekday) rates for 'RV 50/30 amp - Full Hook Up' (inland): $170 in season (10/15/26-12/14/26, 4/1/27-4/30/27), $200 at peak (12/15/26-3/31/27), $135 off season (5/1/26-10/14/26). Weekend and holiday rates run $15-30 higher. The dearest type, Open Water View, is $265 daily at peak. No resort or grounds fee is listed. Extra charges: $15 per person 14+ beyond two, and $50 for a double- or triple-axle trailer (not EKKO).

booking.note: A 4-night minimum applies over Fantasy Fest, Christmas and New Year's. From Oct 15 to Apr 30 'weekly stays may be required for certain site types' (FAQ), with no list of which types. Daily rates are posted for every RV type in every season.

flags: Booking is by phone (US) or a request form (international) only, with no online engine. As an ordinary transient campground it passes the presence rule on its own website, which posts rates and a phone number. The condo-park 'phone/email only' skip does not apply: this is not an owner-lot resort.

Possible seasonal minimum: the FAQ says weekly stays 'may be required for certain site types' from Oct 15 to Apr 30, which is 6.5 months, without saying which types. Daily rates are posted for every RV type in every season, so I judged it not a standing minimum for all sites. I could not test it, because there is no online engine. If AWH reads it as a weekly-only peak on the inland sites, it runs past the 3-month peak limit and would be a drop.
Winter demand: Modern Campground (2023-04-12) said Jan-Mar sites book up to a year ahead and were allocated by lottery. The current site does not mention a lottery.

Monthly rates exist ($4,050-5,700 a month in season). No count of seasonal sites was found, so the 1-in-10 test passes on 'no count'. No homes or lots are sold; the tiny homes and RV rentals are park-owned rentals.
Rig rules: RVs up to 45 ft on select sites, with no class or age restriction found. Restricted dog breeds include German Shepherds, Dobermans, Rottweilers and pit-bull types.
Good Sam directory: not a Good Sam Park (gs false), but military discount true.
Cheapest in-season weeknight a 23-ft rig fits: $170 before 12.5% tax (inland full hookup, Oct 15-Dec 14 and April); $200 at peak (Dec 15-Mar 31).
